description: List every site in the WireBoard account. Returns each site's ID, domain, and max_30d: the highest number of visitors on the site at the same time over the last 30 complete UTC days (max_30d_at is that day). The current day is included once it has ended, so a site whose only traffic is today shows null; null does not mean tracking is broken (use get_aggregate for today). Call this first if you don't know which site_id to use for the other tools.
name: list_sites
title: List sites
